fusions.name: Trailing Stroke
fusions.desc: Sends a bolt of force that deals 4 damage. Its damage rises 10% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it, up to 50%.

fusions.name: Marching Tide
fusions.desc: A wave rolls out from you and deals 28 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. Allies strike 20% harder for 15 seconds after it breaks.

fusions.name: Hardened Stride
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 20% for 15 seconds. Your movement speed rises 25% for 5 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Long Haul
fusions.desc: Your movement speed is permanently increased by 10%.
